title: Jog and Stretch Shuttle
description: Players jog the width of the court doing a different dynamic stretch on each trip to raise body temperature before the ball comes out.

content.objective: Raise heart rate and open up the hips, ankles and shoulders before any ball work.
content.setup: Players line up on the sideline in a group of four or five.
instructions: Jog across doing high knees, then jog back doing butt kicks.
Walk across with lunges and a twist toward the front leg, then walk back with straight-leg kicks.
Side-shuffle across in a low stance, then carioca back.
Finish with two light jogs at an easy pace.
coachingPoints: Keep the group moving together, not racing.
Stay tall during high knees; stay low during the shuffle.
Breathe normally — this is a warm-up, not a sprint.
commonMistakes: Rushing the stretch and losing the movement quality.
Bunching up instead of spreading across the width.
Skipping the easier reps and going straight to full intensity.
content.safety: Check the floor is dry and clear before any lateral movement.
variations: Add a ball to carry (not dribble) on the last two trips.
